subject: Request: Executive signoff for Novatech cross-border terms & vetting
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Executive signoff for Novatech cross-border terms & vetting

Hi Vivek / Karthik (cc Laura),

Quick summary: Novatech Systems (Singapore HQ) is asking for a 25% discount on a 36-month committed Hosted + Dedicated hybrid deployment, plus a limited data residency waiver to allow temporary debugging access from our US support team. They are a manufacturing / industrial IoT software vendor that supplies to multiple OEMs, some of which are in regulated supply chains. Pricing/contract asks are non-standard and we hit a few compliance flags during initial diligence:

- Company does business in SEA and has downstream resellers in two jurisdictions where we need to confirm export license applicability.
- They requested longer retention of transaction logs (18 months vs our standard 90 days).
- They want indemnity language expanded to cover certain product liabilities.

Attachments: Novatech_SOW_v1.pdf (proposal), Novatech_KYC_Form.xlsx (their preliminary data), Novatech_Risk_Memo.docx (my internal note).

What I need from execs:
1) Approval to offer the 25% multi-year discount subject to Legal & Security gating (we're at their preferred-vendor stage; losing price will likely lose the deal).
2) Authority to grant a controlled, timeboxed data-residency exception for debugging (US support access) with mandatory audit trail and SOC2 scope confirmation.
3) Confirmation we can accept an extended log retention only if encryption-at-rest & field-level redaction are in place, and retention limited contractually.

Timeline: Novatech expects an updated, signable proposal by end of day Wednesday (2027-03-31). HubSpot deal ID ND-2027-0345.

Recommended guardrails (from my side):
- Discount contingent on 36-month commitment and prepayment of first 6 months.
- Legal to sign off indemnity redlines; Security to confirm no sanctioned-country deployments.
- No access for any accounts / subentities flagged as sanctioned.

If you approve in principle I will route to Legal + Security for a targeted clause and final sign-off; if not, I plan to propose 15% and maintain standard data residency terms.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Rachel.Kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0128
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive signoff for Novatech cross-border terms & vetting

Rachel — thanks for the concise brief. I support approving the commercial ask (25% on a 36-month committed package) in principle, subject to the following hard conditions: 

1) Legal must approve any indemnity expansion and draft a narrowly scoped clause. No open-ended indemnities.
2) Security to confirm that granting limited US-support access does not introduce cross-border export control violations — explicit confirmation that neither Novatech nor any related entity is on an export/sanctions watchlist.
3) Token/log retention: limit contractually to a maximum of 12 months for logs, must be encrypted at rest with customer-stated controls; redact PII by default.
4) Prepayment: maintain prepay of 6 months as requirement for the full discount.

If Legal + Security can clear the above within 48 hours I authorize Rachel to present an updated proposal and proceed to DocuSign. Karthik, please coordinate Legal review and escalate to Deal Desk if you need tariff/export counsel. Laura, please queue finance for the prepay invoice and confirm whether the discount applies to Hosted only or both Hosted and Dedicated.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | COO, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novatech.com>, Novatech Systems <purchasing@novatech.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Updated proposal & next steps (Novatech / Redwood) — pending Legal/Security signoff

Hi Ellen — good to speak yesterday. Per our conversation, we've provisionally cleared pricing at 25% off the standard list for a 36-month commitment, pending Legal and Security final sign-off on a few limited items.

What's attached: Novatech_Proposal_v2.pdf (commercial terms reflecting the 25% discount and 36-month commitment), and a KYC form (please review and complete KYC_Form_Filled.xlsx). We also need a short compliance questionnaire filled for export control screening; I'll attach our standard Compliance QA below.

Key conditions to note (per internal approval team):
- Prepayment of first 6 months is required for the full discount to apply.
- Any data-residency exception for US support access will be timeboxed to 90 days and require audit logs and field-level redaction.
- Log retention will be capped at 12 months and encrypted at rest.
- Indemnity language: we can accept a limited expansion subject to Legal drafting (we will share proposed redlines).

DocuSign link (provisional): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123def
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ND-2027-0345

Attachments: Novatech_Proposal_v2.pdf, KYC_Form_Filled.xlsx

Please return the KYC + Compliance QA by Tuesday 2027-03-30 so Legal and Security can complete review. If you have constraints on the prepayment cadence, let us know and we can discuss a limited alternative.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novatech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated proposal & next steps (Novatech / Redwood) — pending Legal/Security signoff

Rachel — thanks for the fast turnaround. We appreciate Redwood moving quickly on pricing. A few quick items from our side:

1) We will complete the KYC and Compliance QA today and return the signed KYC by EOD.
2) The 6-month prepayment is aggressive for our CFO; can you confirm whether the discount can be split (50% upfront + 6 monthly installments) and still qualify? If not, we may need to ask for a slightly smaller discount.
3) Regarding the data residency exception: we confirm we do not operate in any sanctioned jurisdictions and will provide the subsidiary list as part of the KYC.
4) We do have an export-compliance questionnaire that may help expedite the screening — attaching our short form (Novatech_Compliance_QA.pdf).

If Legal wants more detail on downstream customers we can provide it under NDA. Please confirm the applicability of the discount to Hosted vs Dedicated, and we will push our procurement team to return the signed doc.

Best,
Ellen Park
VP, Global Procurement | Novatech Systems
ellen.park@novatech.com
Attachments: Novatech_Compliance_QA.pdf
